EuroDigital — Victoria & Vancouver Island, BC (Canada)

EuroDigital builds professional websites and practical digital growth systems for Victoria and Vancouver Island service businesses, makers, and small shops — clear scope, search and analytics foundations, stronger customer paths, measurable setup, and a handoff you own. EuroDigital does not guarantee rankings or revenue, and ongoing growth support is optional rather than a required long-term retainer.

Core offer:
- Small business website launches and online stores
- Practical growth foundations that can include analytics, Search Console, local-search structure, conversion paths, attribution, and Google Business Profile support when appropriate
- Small Website Repairs for narrowly scoped fixes on existing sites
- Optional ongoing improvement support can be scoped separately when measurement shows it is useful
- Includes (package-dependent): mobile-first design, contact or store flows, Analytics + Search Console, Google Business Profile support when it fits, basic SEO structure, domain/hosting setup, and a clear ownership handoff

Most likely project types:
1. Local service business websites (trades, contractors, landscapers, etc.) — example: MaestrosServices
2. Creative brand or maker websites (showcase + inquiries) — example: AnglKissCreations
3. Online stores (catalog, cart, checkout, payments) — example: StarMapCo
